description: This file defines the NetworkFlowMonitorClient class which extends the AwsClient class, providing methods for interacting with the Network Flow Monitor service in AWS. The class includes method annotations for various actions like creating, deleting, retrieving, starting, stopping, tagging, and updating network flow monitor resources.

classes.name: NetworkFlowMonitorClient
classes.description: Client class to interact with AWS Network Flow Monitor service, extending AwsClient to provide specific service methods.
